column3: NKJV has “the Lord God of the holy prophets,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets.”
NKJV has “those who do His commandments,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “those who wash their robes.”
NKJV has “from the Book of Life,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “from the tree of life.”
NKJV has “our Lord Jesus Christ … with you all,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord Jesus … with all.”
